SELECT s.format, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl,
 sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.status, w.fulfilment_type, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 count(r.return_line_id) ret_lines, sum(r.refund_net) refund,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' THEN f.net_amount END) net_dispatched_in_p2

JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zz, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2

SELECT count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refund_gt_sold,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_gt,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date > f.sale_date + 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over30,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net/NULLIF(f.net_amount,0) - r.quantity_returned*1.0/f.quantity) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prorata_off
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount),2) sold_net, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0),2) returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       count(DISTINCT l.format) chk
FROM sold l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT format) formats, count(*) versions, max(format) FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1 OR store_id>=900
